title: Seriously Clear Rubi Passion Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Seriously Clear Rubi Passion Ice delivers a thrilling tropical experience with a frosty, refreshing finish. The blend is built around the intense, aromatic sweetness of juicy Passionfruit, offering a vibrant and exotic fruit profile on the inhale. This is swiftly followed by a brisk, clean wave of Ice on the exhale, which cools the palate and perfectly complements the rich tropical notes. The extra-concentrated flavourings ensure this exotic and chilled mix is incredibly punchy. Mixed to a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is optimised for low-powered MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices, such as pod vape kits and pen-style starter kits. The premium nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it a highly effective option for everyday use. For the best performance and clear flavour delivery, it is recommended to pair this e-liquid with coils or pods ranging between 0.8ohm and 1.2ohm. The Seriously Clear collection by the acclaimed UK mixologists at Doozy Vape Co. and Crystal Clear offers a premium range of double-concentrated "bar salt" e-liquids. Designed to provide maximum flavour intensity with a remarkably clean finish, this line focuses on sharp, vibrant fruit and sour profiles. Supplied in a 10ml bottle, this e-liquid is available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, providing a versatile and satisfying choice for your refillable device.
